gitCommit.subject: fix: deleteResult deletes children + result atomically (nea follow-up) (#215)
gitCommit.body:
fix: deleteResult deletes children + result atomically (nea follow-up) (#215)

* fix(sort): deleteResult deletes children + result atomically via withTransaction (purses-nea follow-up)

Wrap deleteResult's two deletes (children then result) in withTransaction
with tx-bound repos so a mid-delete failure rolls both back, leaving no
partial state. Add an un-mocked DB-integration atomicity test that pins a
sort_result_share to the draft (sortResultId FK has ON DELETE no action),
forcing the result-row delete to FK-violate after the item deletes run —
proving the items survive the rollback. Update the deleteResult unit tests
(service + route) to the transactional shape (fakeTxDb + tx-bound repo mocks).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(api): deleteResult is now atomic (one transaction) — purses-nea follow-up
